chapterInfo.content:
6
Asɔrefie no wie
1Ɛnna Ɔhene Dario hyɛɛ sɛ wɔnkɔhwehwɛ nwoma fie, deɛ wɔde akoradeɛ sie wɔ Babel no. 2Nso, kuro Ekbatana a ɛwɔ Media mansini mu na wɔkɔhunuu nwoma mmobɔeɛ, a wɔatwerɛ asɛm bi wɔ mu sei sɛ: 3#Esra 1.1 Ɔhene Kores afe a ɛdi kan mu no, ɔhyɛɛ mmara sɛ: Nyankopɔn fie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no ho deɛ, wɔnsi efie no mma no nyɛ afɔrebɔbea, na ne korɔn nyɛ basafa aduasa, ne trɛ basafa aduasa nso, 4aboɔ akɛseɛ nkyerɛpɛn mmiɛnsa ne nnua nso kyerɛpɛn baako. Na ɛho ahweredeɛ no, wɔmfa mfiri ɔhene fie mma. 5Nso Nyankopɔn fie sika ne dwetɛ nnwinneɛ a Nebukadnessar kɔfa firii Yerusalem asɔredan mu de baa Babel no, wɔnsane mfa mma, na ɛnkɔ Yerusalem asɔredan no mu ne siberɛ hɔ, na wɔnnya no Nyankopɔn fie hɔ.
6Afei wo Tatenai, asuogya amrado ne Setar-Bosnai ne mo agyinatufoɔ Afarsakafoɔ a mowɔ Asuogya no, momfiri hɔ nkɔ akyiri. 7Momma Nyankopɔn fie adwuma no ntena hɔ, na Yudafoɔ amrado ne Yudafoɔ mpanimfoɔ no nsi Nyankopɔn fie no ne siberɛ hɔ. 8Na me na merehyɛ makyerɛ deɛ monyɛ mma Yudafoɔ mpanimfoɔ no na wɔnsi Nyankopɔn fie no: Ɛne sɛ, ɔhene nnoɔma a ɛne asuogya toɔ no, wɔmfa mu bi ntua ahweredeɛ no ka pɛpɛɛpɛ mmammarima no, na amma wɔannyae. 9Na adeɛ a ɛhia wɔn no, nantwie mma ne adwennini ne nnwan mma a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ayuo, nkyene, nsa ne ngo, sɛdeɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no bɛgyeɛ no, wɔmfa mma wɔn, da biara da, na wɔmmma ebi nnka, 10na wɔmmɔ afɔdeɛ hwamhwam mma ɔsoro Nyankopɔn, na wɔnyi ɔhene ne ne mma nkwa so apaeɛ. 11Mehyɛ bio sɛ, obiara a ɔbɛdane asɛm yi ani no, wɔnyi ne dan so mpuna mma so nsi hɔ, na wɔmmɔ no mfam ho, na ne fie nnane sumina. 12Na Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne din tena hɔ no bɛbutu ɔhene ne ɔman biara a wɔtene wɔn nsa dane ani, sɛ wɔbɛbubu Nyankopɔn fie yi wɔ Yerusalem. Me Dario na mahyɛ mmara yi, ma wɔnni so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
13Ɛnna Tatenai, asuogya amrado no ne Setar-Bosnai ne wɔn mfɛfoɔ no, deɛ Ɔhene Dario ama wɔabɛka no nti, wɔyɛɛ saa pɛpɛɛpɛ. 14Na Yudafoɔ mpanimfoɔ sisii, na ɛyɛɛ yie, Odiyifoɔ Hagai ne Ido ba Sakaria nkɔmhyɛ no nti. Na wɔsisii na wɔwiee, sɛdeɛ Israel Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne Persiahene Kores ne Dario ne Artasasta mmara no teɛ no. 15#Esra 4.24 Na wɔwiee efie no bosome Adar da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa so, Ɔhene Dario ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so nsia mu.
16 # Num 7.10; 1 Ah 8.62-66 Na Israelfoɔ, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ ne atukɔfoɔ no nkaeɛ de ahosan dii Nyankopɔn fie anobue da no. 17#Esra 8.35 Na wɔbobɔɔ Nyankopɔn fie anobue no ho afɔdeɛ: Anantwinini ɔha, adwennini ahanu, nnwammaa ahanan, ne mpapo a wɔde bɔɔ Israel nyinaa tiri bɔne ho afɔdeɛ, dummienu; sɛdeɛ Israel mmusuakuo ano teɛ no. 18#Num 3.6; 8.24 Na wɔde asɔfoɔ no sisii wɔn akuakuo so, ne Lewifoɔ no, wɔn nkyekyɛmu so maa Nyankopɔn som Yerusalem, sɛdeɛ wɔtwerɛɛ no Mose nwoma no mu no.
19 # Eks 12.6 Na atukɔfoɔ no dii Twam no, bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan so. 20Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no dwiraa wɔn ho sɛ onipa baako, wɔn nyinaa ho firii, na wɔkunkumm Twam adwammaa no maa atukɔfoɔ no nyinaa ne wɔn nuanom asɔfoɔ no ne wɔn ara. 21Na Israelfoɔ a wɔfiri otukorɔ mu baeɛ no ne wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho afiri asase no so amanaman no afideɛ ho baa wɔn nkyɛn bɛhwehwɛɛ AWURADE Israel Nyankopɔn no dii Twam dwan no, 22na wɔdii apiti dapɔnna nnanson, anigyeɛ mu, ɛfiri sɛ AWURADE maa wɔn ani gyee, na ɔkomm Asiriahene no akoma baa wɔn so, maa no hyɛɛ wɔn abasam den, Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no, fie adwuma no mu.

Nso, kuro Ekbatana a ɛwɔ Media mansini mu na wɔkɔhunuu nwoma mmobɔeɛ, a wɔatwerɛ asɛm bi wɔ mu sei sɛ: Ɔhene Kores afe a ɛdi kan mu no, ɔhyɛɛ mmara sɛ: Nyankopɔn fie a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no ho deɛ, wɔnsi efie no mma no nyɛ afɔrebɔbea, na ne korɔn nyɛ basafa aduasa, ne trɛ basafa aduasa nso, aboɔ akɛseɛ nkyerɛpɛn mmiɛnsa ne nnua nso kyerɛpɛn baako. Na ɛho ahweredeɛ no, wɔmfa mfiri ɔhene fie mma. Nso Nyankopɔn fie sika ne dwetɛ nnwinneɛ a Nebukadnessar kɔfa firii Yerusalem asɔredan mu de baa Babel no, wɔnsane mfa mma, na ɛnkɔ Yerusalem asɔredan no mu ne siberɛ hɔ, na wɔnnya no Nyankopɔn fie hɔ.

Na me na merehyɛ makyerɛ deɛ monyɛ mma Yudafoɔ mpanimfoɔ no na wɔnsi Nyankopɔn fie no: Ɛne sɛ, ɔhene nnoɔma a ɛne asuogya toɔ no, wɔmfa mu bi ntua ahweredeɛ no ka pɛpɛɛpɛ mmammarima no, na amma wɔannyae. Na adeɛ a ɛhia wɔn no, nantwie mma ne adwennini ne nnwan mma a wɔde bɛbɔ ɔsoro Nyankopɔn hyeɛ afɔdeɛ, ayuo, nkyene, nsa ne ngo, sɛdeɛ asɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Yerusalem no bɛgyeɛ no, wɔmfa mma wɔn, da biara da, na wɔmmma ebi nnka, na wɔmmɔ afɔdeɛ hwamhwam mma ɔsoro Nyankopɔn, na wɔnyi ɔhene ne ne mma nkwa so apaeɛ. Mehyɛ bio sɛ, obiara a ɔbɛdane asɛm yi ani no, wɔnyi ne dan so mpuna mma so nsi hɔ, na wɔmmɔ no mfam ho, na ne fie nnane sumina. Na Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne din tena hɔ no bɛbutu ɔhene ne ɔman biara a wɔtene wɔn nsa dane ani, sɛ wɔbɛbubu Nyankopɔn fie yi wɔ Yerusalem. Me Dario na mahyɛ mmara yi, ma wɔnni so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
Ɛnna Tatenai, asuogya amrado no ne Setar-Bosnai ne wɔn mfɛfoɔ no, deɛ Ɔhene Dario ama wɔabɛka no nti, wɔyɛɛ saa pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na Yudafoɔ mpanimfoɔ sisii, na ɛyɛɛ yie, Odiyifoɔ Hagai ne Ido ba Sakaria nkɔmhyɛ no nti. Na wɔsisii na wɔwiee, sɛdeɛ Israel Nyankopɔn ahyɛdeɛ ne Persiahene Kores ne Dario ne Artasasta mmara no teɛ no. Na wɔwiee efie no bosome Adar da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa so, Ɔhene Dario ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so nsia mu.
Na Israelfoɔ, asɔfoɔ, Lewifoɔ ne atukɔfoɔ no nkaeɛ de ahosan dii Nyankopɔn fie anobue da no. Na atukɔfoɔ no dii Twam no, bosome a ɛdi kan no da a ɛtɔ so dunan so. Na asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no dwiraa wɔn ho sɛ onipa baako, wɔn nyinaa ho firii, na wɔkunkumm Twam adwammaa no maa atukɔfoɔ no nyinaa ne wɔn nuanom asɔfoɔ no ne wɔn ara. app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
